title: Building a UI with a 100% LLM-driven workflow (still very experimental)
author: Gaebabi
selftext:
Trying a slightly different way of doing UI work in Unity lately.

I’ve been using a React-based browser twin of my Unity UI, so I can look at the screen and comment on things directly.

as long as the theme context is in place, you can build the UI you want very quickly.

for small UI issues, instead of writing out a full bug report or trying to explain the whole screen, I just point at whatever feels off and leave a short comment.

one thing I still find difficult is getting rid of that AI slop look and making the UI actually feel like it belongs in a polished mobile game.

of course, I can imagine this causing quite a bit of friction in a team setting. but for solo developers, I think it can be a really powerful workflow, so I wanted to share this experiment.
